title: Absorbed Essence: Illasera (Condition)
html:
Absorbed Essence: Illasera

  •  Sarevok is permanently  Hastened and can't be  Paralysed,  Restrained, or have his movement speed reduced in any way.

Properties

UID: LOW_SAREVOK_ESSENCE_ILLASERA

 Stack ID: HASTE

 Status groups: SG_RemoveOnRespec

 Loses duration: start of turn

 Stack priority: 10

Honour mode

  • Sarevok cannot use  Extra Attack with his second action.
  • Applying  Slowed to him removes and blocks this condition as long as Sarevok is Slowed.[See Notes]

Notes

  • This condition grants Sarevok immunity to all  Paralyzed,  Restrained, and  Difficult Terrain conditions. It also prevents his movement speed from being reduced.
  • In honour mode only, Slowed and similar conditions end this condition. This is because for honour mode specifically, these conditions are assigned the HASTE stack ID and a higher stack priority than this condition.
    • Sarevok regains this condition at the end of his turn if he is no longer Slowed.

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID HASTE, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects

  • Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn.[See: Bugs]

  • Affected entity has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed is doubled, and it can take one additional  Action per turn.
